text: Story room read whole against story-p1: anarcho_capitalism (sampled fails for A10), told-with-residue. Calls then building (A01), defence (A03), truces and a border request late (A04), bots after upkeep (A06), the snek celebrated, a timelapse, clones and pxls.space after (A08, A09). A10 fails: moves by choice came before doubt. Residue: from the first hour the room's work was converting a rival faction's flag inside an ideological contest; the story has no step for attack as a room's own work.

Story room read whole against story-p1: canucks (sampled fails for A06), told-with-residue. A proposal answered within the hour (A02), a stalled first logo, then a call, a Discord and a finished logo within an hour (A01, A07), a night shift and defence (A03), a border approved by GreenLattice (A04), the logo mostly untouched at h73. Residue: the room's first canvas work was attacking the Flames logo with spare accounts, before it built its own; machine hands served an attack before any upkeep (A06 fails, as sampled); the story has no step for attack as a room's own work.

Story room read whole against story-p1: edmontonoilers (sampled fails for A05), told-with-residue. A start answered within the hour (A02), recruiting and building (A01), 'We did it' then vigilance (A07, A03), a maintenance script after upkeep (A06), the logo lost to the Void at the close, a promise to defend it if r/place returns. Residue: the first acts were calls to deface Calgary's logo; the room then made its rival a partner (sparing at h12.9, logos side by side, a defence pact), sparing long before border talk (A05 fails, as sampled); a vote decided the design switch.

Story room read whole against story-p1: empiredidnothingwrong (sampled fails for A11), told-with-residue. Calls then building (A01), 'We did it men!' (A07), defence against Italian bots and repair to the template (A03), the Italian route-around after upkeep (A04), sparing the Yeezy shoe for maintenance (A05), the final symbol celebrated and a memorial asked for on the new r/place. Residue: the template came with the first call and the design was never argued (A11 fails); alts built the centre before any upkeep; the room divided its work by role in character, a decided element of order.

Story room read whole against story-p1: texans (sampled fails for A09), told-with-residue. A blueprint and a stickied call (A02), early moves by choice, a treaty with r/placehearts, done at h25.5 and celebrated (A01, A07), defence after (A03), Discord diplomacy (A04), a protection script after upkeep (A06), the final form put in the flair pool. Residue: the flair request came at h34.5, while the work was still kept (A09 fails); a second mark built as a taunt at the Colts; help repaid to r/placehearts.

Story room read whole against story-p1: texas (sampled fails for A11), told-with-residue. Calls then building (A01), defence (A03), the Yogscast beard deal and the Kolache alliance after upkeep (A04), restraint by agreement (A05), scripts after upkeep (A06), doubt before the move (A10), the flag lost to Norway, retaken, moved under Crusader Kings' protection, regards exchanged at the close. Residue: the template came with the first call (A11 fails); after the loss the room called other subs and university groups for help, against the story's relocation sentence; the move was negotiated with other rooms; the fight was told as national history.

Story room read whole against story-p1: totallynotrobots (sampled fails for A05), told-with-residue. The robot-pretence play filled h-7 to h42; the canvas work began at h69.9 with an image and coordinates at once; talk with r/patriots over the scoreboard; an appeal over the fox before any border talk (A05 fails); a move beside the fox at h73.19 cut by the clock; an apology to r/foxes; PlaceTwo after. Residue: the play set what the room made (a CAPTCHA placed by hand as proof of being human), not only when; the close mourned an unfinished work.

Story room read whole against story-p1: xenoblade_chronicles (sampled fails for A01), told-with-residue. A member began the Monado before any call (A01's bound), completion celebrated (A07), defence (A03), border talk with green lattice, the Seahawks and Bulgaria (A04), a one-pixel border kept (A05), survival at the close. Residue: r/Bulgaria's members came to stop their own room's invasion and defended the sword jointly; the early move away from the void was a precaution.

Story room read whole against story-p1: yuyuyu (items quartile 1), told-with-residue. April Fools play, then a bare announcement, then an envoy from r/swissneutralityzone offering space to write C-Shadow in return for defending Swiss land; the work stood and was celebrated at the close; a plan for next time. Residue: the deal came first and the work sat in another room's protected space, against the story's order from building to border talk (A04's bound).

Story room read whole against story-p1: catalunya (items quartile 2), told-with-residue. A proposal answered by a call (A02), a drawing to copy, repair after building (A03), truces after upkeep (A04), attacks called off after a deal (A05), a script after upkeep (A06), 'Ho hem aconseguit' at the close (A07), the flag recorded for posterity (A08). Residue: the room grew by erasing a neighbour's mark against a truce, then traded help with r/Factorio and r/TheLastAirbender.

Story room read whole against story-p1: scp (items quartile 3), told-with-residue. A proposal answered by calls and a blueprint (A02, A01), repeated losses and new attempts, lettering repaired late (A03), no celebration, a picture of the finished work and a Discord kept after the close. Residue: after each loss the room proposed anew and called again, against the story's relocation sentence; members' pixels were tied up in other rooms' work; members feared the mark would draw newcomers to the wiki.

Story room read whole against story-p1: sweden (items quartile 4), told-with-residue. The whole spine shows: a start with a blue dot and calls (A02, A01), repair (A03), sparing by request (A05), a script after upkeep (A06), celebration (A07), records (A08), the banner and the Maryland friendship carried on (A09). A04 fails: peace talk with Norway came before any upkeep. Residue: the defining act was a scheduled attack converting Denmark's flag; the flag became a host for dozens of other rooms' works, granted by Discord vote and repaid in night repairs; moderators moved canvas talk to r/SwedenOnPlace.

Story room read whole against story-p1: ripcity (seeded from the rest), told-with-residue. Every arrow of the spine and the close shows in order (A02, A01, A03, A04, A05, A06, A07, A08, A09). Residue: the room traded help with neighbours and built their marks beside its own (Timbers, Jazz, CompSoc's pixels for maintenance); a vote settled the border colour; attacks came as rival fans rewriting letters.

Story room read whole against story-p1: worldoftanks (sampled fails for A02), told-with-residue. The April Fools play filled the first day; a call to draw a tank came before any start (A02 fails); building after the organizing thread (A01); a pact before any upkeep (A04 fails); upkeep after the build (A03); four attempts, each after a loss, with renewed calls; a late proposal cut by hour 73. All 20 story rooms for pass 1 are read; every verdict is told-with-residue.

Saturation line for pass 1 appended to saturation.jsonl: story model/story-p1.md, 20 rooms read whole, told 0, told-with-residue 20, not-told 0; stopping rule for pass 1: 35 tier_history events at C2 (7 dimension cuts, 28 fourth-order lines given their C2 fields), 12 arrows added, first story. The residues cluster: help and exchange between rooms (ubc, xenoblade_chronicles, catalunya, texans, sweden, ripcity, MiamiHurricanes, yuyuyu, edmontonoilers); attack as a room's own work (anarcho_capitalism, canucks, edmontonoilers, catalunya, sweden, unitedkingdom); calls renewed after a loss, against the story's relocation sentence (day9, texas, scp, worldoftanks); border talk before any upkeep, against A04 (unitedkingdom, sweden, yuyuyu, worldoftanks); the template arriving with the first call (empiredidnothingwrong, texas, totallynotrobots); the close marking an unfinished work (ultrahardcore, totallynotrobots); membership and host policing (unitedkingdom, texas, sweden); decided elements by vote (edmontonoilers, sweden, ripcity, empiredidnothingwrong). These are pass 2's material.

Two open distinctions written to out/_questions/ (each under 600 words, status open): contention-dimension (whether Attribution, Repertoire of contention and Rivalry form a contention dimension, against keeping attack and rivalry in Order without law; pass 1 found no arrow from attribution, and attack was a room's own work in 6 of 20 story rooms) and relocation-renewed-calls (whether a move sends a room back to recruiting: F-002's count against 4 of 20 story rooms renewing calls after a loss; a window test before and after the first move would decide).

Findings written (rule 14), move relating: the elements written at this leg cited F-002 to F-005, and C01 cited F-001, but findings.jsonl held only F-001, the stage B1 claim about the 197 kinds; the pass 1 findings had been planned and never written. Appended by out/_analysis/c2_findings_p1.py, every number recomputed: F-002 (inferred) calls and builds after a move rarer than a shuffle predicts (57 of 79, 0.722 against 0.962; 49 of 65, 0.754 against 0.939), bounded as a corpus rate contested by day9, texas, scp and worldoftanks; F-003 (read) day9 stopped because its second work was finished and held; F-004 (inferred) the close runs in order (0.645, 0.779, 0.779); F-005 (inferred) machine hands under strain (0.788 against 0.603; reverse 0.202 against 0.375); F-006 (read) decided order placed in 46 of 705 rooms against 526 for repair and 522 for the completion ritual. C01's evidence now cites F-006, with one model/history.jsonl line carrying the old element as was. model.md corrected in place: C01 cites F-006, and the relocation sentences now say a move returns a room to recruiting less often than chance, naming the four story rooms that called again; story-p1.md keeps its sentence as read.
